title: Provider-neutral Forge seam and the GitHub adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral `Forge` trait (branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, head commit, capabilities) with an in-memory `FakeForge` double and a `report_change` step that runs the Report sequence in one fixed order. A new `github` module becomes the first adapter, moving every `gh` invocation out of `pr_status` and `review` and behind the trait, and `main.rs` rewires `review post`, `review run --post-to`, `pr status apply` and `pr status refresh` to call the forge instead of shelling out directly. A new `osf forge pr open` command opens a pull request through the adapter, and the `develop` skill documents the job that uses it.

lanes.label: Adapters
lanes.subtitle: code-host implementations

nodes.label: osf review post
nodes.subtitle: review_post_cmd
nodes.summary: Builds the review plan, reads the head commit through the forge, and posts through `post_plan`; reports the result as a `PostedReview` or a `ForgeError`.

nodes.label: review run --post-to
nodes.subtitle: post_run_outcome
nodes.summary: The same posting path for a review run: reads the head commit from the forge and posts the plan, printing the review or advisory-comment outcome.

nodes.label: post_plan
nodes.subtitle: plan -> NewReview -> forge.post_review
nodes.summary: Converts a review plan into a `forge::NewReview` and hands it to the forge; the self-review fallback now lives in the adapter.

nodes.label: osf pr status apply
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_apply_cmd
nodes.summary: Dry run still reads the body through the client; a real apply now calls `forge.write_status_block` with the block text.

nodes.label: osf pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_refresh_run
nodes.summary: Reads checks through `forge.read_check_status` and writes the rendered block through `forge.write_status_block`, keeping the client only for body, review and PR-info reads.

nodes.label: osf forge pr open
nodes.subtitle: forge_pr_open_cmd
nodes.summary: New command: requires a builder token, resolves the repo from `--repo` or the origin remote, reads the body file, prepends the work item line, and opens the pull request through the adapter.

nodes.label: github_adapter()
nodes.subtitle: the only place that builds GitHub<RealGh>
nodes.summary: Single construction point for the real adapter, so every command shares one wiring decision.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: create_branch, open_pull_request, write_status_block, post_review, read_check_status, head_commit, capabilities
nodes.summary: The seam between the factory and a code host. Nothing in the module names a provider, a URL or a command; `ReadOutcome` distinguishes found, empty and unknown reads.

nodes.label: Forge request/response types
nodes.subtitle: PullRequestId, NewReview, PostedReview, Capabilities
nodes.summary: Plain serializable data for every operation, including `Verdict`, `ReadOutcome`, `VerdictCapability` and `ReadCapability`.

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: the Report step, one fixed order
nodes.summary: Opens the pull request, writes the status block, reads capabilities, posts the review only when the identity may, then reads the check status; a failed step stops the run and names itself.

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.subtitle: in-memory double with a call log and scripts
nodes.summary: Records every call as plain data, answers from defaults or scripted sequences, and can be told to fail one operation; performs no process, file, network or clock work.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: impl Forge for GitHub<C: GhClient>
nodes.summary: Translates each trait method into command-line calls through the `GhClient` seam, parses the JSON answers, and classifies failures into `ForgeError::Rejected` or `Failed`.

nodes.label: Self-review fallback
nodes.subtitle: post_with_fallback
nodes.summary: Posts the review once; on a self-review refusal it warns and retries the same findings as an advisory COMMENT, preserving the old command-line behaviour.

nodes.label: Capability probe
nodes.subtitle: verdict_capability, check_status_capability
nodes.summary: Reads the viewer and author logins and the check command's exit to decide which verdicts the identity may give and whether checks are readable, unreadable or unknown.

nodes.label: GhClient seam
nodes.subtitle: run, view_body, view_checks, edit_body
nodes.summary: The trait over the command-line tool gained a raw `run` method and a `GhOutput` struct; the real implementation moved out of `pr_status` into the adapter.

nodes.label: pr_status pure helpers
nodes.subtitle: parse_checks, gates_from_checks
nodes.summary: Check parsing was split from gate rendering so the adapter can read checks as data and the renderer can still build the gate spec; the module now holds no process-starting code.

nodes.label: review pure helpers
nodes.subtitle: payload, classify_post_result, parse_head_sha_json
nodes.summary: The decision logic for payloads and refusal classification stays pure; `fetch_head_sha` and `post_via_gh` were removed now that the adapter owns those calls.

nodes.label: Code host
nodes.subtitle: pull requests, reviews, checks, identity
nodes.summary: The remote host the adapter drives: it accepts or refuses branch refs, pull requests, status-block edits, reviews and check reads, and decides what the current identity may do.

chips.label: gh call sites moved behind the seam

views.title: Forge seam and its callers
views.summary: The new trait sits between the CLI commands and the code host; the GitHub adapter is the only implementation that reaches the host, and the fake double is the only one that does not.

views.title: Inside the GitHub adapter
views.summary: How one adapter method becomes command-line calls: the raw `run` seam, the pure review and status helpers, and the capability probe.
